newsitem.title: UK: 3i Europe private equity fund raises 537 ecu.
newsitem.headline: 3i Europe private equity fund raises 537 ecu.

text.p: UK specialist investor 3i said Thursday it had raised 537 million ECU for its new fund for private equity investment in continental Europe.
The fund, called Eurofund II, raised at its first closing 268.5 million ECU from 3i and a like amount from eight institutional investors from the UK, U.S., and Asia.
Eurofund II will make investments in unquoted companies in Europe.
"Institutional investors view this as an opportunity to gain early market entry into Continental businesses at a time when pricing is attractive," 3i director Charles Richardson told Reuters.
3i had set a target of 500 million ECU for the first closing.
Two other UK-based investment managers have launched similar funds in recent weeks, seeking to capitalise on investor's desire to tap the European private equity market.
Schroeder Ventures last month launched a $1 billion private equity investment fund. Charterhouse Capital in early June inaugurated an 800 million sterling European buy-out fund.
Eurofund II will hold a second closing later in the year that will bring the fund to a maximum size of 650 ECU with no more than 12 investors.
